releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.15:
- Enhanced Kitchen Tickets: Cleaned header badges, removed redundant Hot Kitchen tag, eliminated individual [TO GO] tags on to-go orders, and double-height fonts preventing text clipping.
- Spanish Kitchen KDS: Native full Spanish interface toggle (EN / ES) for Kitchen Displays and dedicated 1-click Spanish KDS installer.
- 1-Click Cart Modification: Edit any active cart item directly without deleting.
- Open Tabs Combine: Seamlessly combine existing tabs into active checkout cart.
- Back Office Multi-Station Discovery: Automatic DHCP server rediscovery on port 38899.
- Clean virgin database with zero preloaded mock data.
